title: HAPPY BIRTHDAY, Faithfully Crafted!
alt: HAPPY BIRTHDAY, Faithfully Crafted! — handmade crochet characters by Faith
body:
HAPPY BIRTHDAY, Faithfully Crafted!
I came so far.
A year ago, I spontaneously decided to sell crochet items as a fun thing to do, a hobby where I can occupy free time. Who would have thought that I would last a year in this journey, and hopefully more years.
Everything started when my BF bought me crochet hooks as a gift because I've been requesting them. During those times I really want to start doing something new and I'm like "hey, why don't I try crochet?" and as supportive as he is, he immediately bought me a set for me to try the uncertainty (because I get bored easily with my hobby and I jump from one thing to the other). Nevertheless, I started crocheting and my first creation is the bee in this picture. I remember being so proud of it, showing it to my friends, my mom, and my brothers.
Afterwards, the support grew... My friends are pushing me to sell my creations even if I'm just a newbie at that time. I thought about it for a while, then I went through it.
Then, there came a time where my mom would buy yarn whenever I requested them, my brothers would buy me stands and hooks as I would like to have those. They never questioned, they never asked for anything in return. JUST PURE SUPPORT.
Because of all that, I am thankful for everyone that believed. My lovely Mom, brothers, SANRIO, and my boyfriend. Thank you for not doubting me towards the path I am taking. Although it is clear to me that for now crocheting is still a hobby, a fun one at that. But I love the things that I do. I will continue to create and spread the love I am receiving through my craft. This page opened up new opportunities for me, new connections that I will further build and cherish.
In addition, thank you to my clients and those that help me sell my craft. I am very grateful.🩷
-Faith
